title: EvidenceArtefactRecordedPayload
description: Payload of the EvidenceArtefactRecorded platform event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8, §28.18; class: platform; FR-AH.15, INV-REQ-1226 b1-b2, INV-ADR-285). Owned by service-runtime alone (STK-61), as drafted in INV-API-3310 (INV-Q-3257). Authored by INV-T-3313; hash and artefactType ruled by INV-Q-3341 (b). evidence-svc records each artefact once: unique on (artefactType, reference, hash). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

artefactType.description: The kind of evidence artefact recorded (INV-API-3310, INV-Q-3341): RENDITION, a payload-svc rendition (INV-REQ-1036); SAMPLE_CHECK, a rendition sample check with its samples and result, payload-svc (INV-REQ-1036 b2, INV-AC-2010); REGISTER_LOOKUP, a Peppol directory or Check GST Register lookup, masterdata-svc (INV-REQ-802 b2, INV-REQ-478, INV-REQ-1290); RATE_RECORD, an effective-dated exchange-rate record with its load provenance, masterdata-svc (INV-REQ-506 b3, INV-REQ-512, INV-AC-1512); IMPORT, an import record, masterdata-svc counterparty imports and rules-svc mapping-pack re-imports (INV-REQ-833 b1, b3, INV-REQ-831 b4); SIGNATORY_ACTION, a client signatory's acknowledge, query or withdraw-consent on the mapping outcome summary, access-svc (INV-REQ-900 b3, INV-AC-926, INV-AC-1936, INV-REQ-997 b2). Extensible (API-09, API-41): a new value is added additively within v1; evidence-svc keeps a value it does not know as received, never drops or rewrites it.

reference.description: The producer's reference to the recorded artefact.

hash.description: The SHA-256 of the artefact bytes as 64 lowercase hex characters, the platform's one algorithm (INV-REQ-650 b2, INV-AC-2206; INV-Q-3341), so (artefactType, reference, hash) is unique across producers.
